entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had a whole speech prepared. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had a whole speech prepared. But now that we're all here, let's just raise a toast."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They looked at one another, seeming..."
entries.dialogueText: They looked at one another, seemingly relieved.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A wise man once said, 'Resistance..."
entries.dialogueText: "A wise man once said, 'Resistance to change is futile when the wheels of time turn unceasingly.'"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've called everyone here as a cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've called everyone here as a courtesy to inform you that there are going to be some changes around here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't want it to come to this...."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't want it to come to this. But alas, here we are."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once inside, I closed the door, lea..."
entries.dialogueText: Once inside, I closed the door, leaving the celebrations behind us.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You've already outdone yourself wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've already outdone yourself with the renovations, Your Majesty. No need to gild the lily."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a ripple of light laughte..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a ripple of light laughter.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For centuries, the monarchy has be..."
entries.dialogueText: "For centuries, the monarchy has been the stabilizing force of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Through hardship and prosperity, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Through hardship and prosperity, the Crown has stood firm, guiding this nation through its darkest and brightest days."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While Rizia’s past should be celeb..."
entries.dialogueText: "While Rizia’s past should be celebrated and revered, we cannot afford to become stuck in it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Clinging too tightly to tradition..."
entries.dialogueText: "Clinging too tightly to tradition risks dragging us into ruin."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Are you saying tradition is a burd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you saying tradition is a burden now?"

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""Are you suggesting that tradition..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you suggesting that tradition is a burden now?

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: "You’re speaking in riddles, dear.""
entries.dialogueText: You’re speaking in riddles, dear."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You’re speaking in riddles, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re speaking in riddles, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You’re speaking in riddles, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re speaking in riddles, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, just what exactly are you try..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, just what exactly are you trying to tell us?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""You’re speaking in riddles, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re speaking in riddles, Your Majesty. Just what exactly is it you're trying to tell us?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Yes, just what exactly are you try..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, just what exactly are you trying to tell us?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Just what exactly are you trying t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just what exactly are you trying to tell us?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Quiet, everyone. Let His Majesty s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quiet, everyone. Let His Majesty speak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I intend to transform Rizia into a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I intend to transform Rizia into a democratic republic -- one governed by the people, for the people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guests froze, their eyes reflec..."
entries.dialogueText: The guests froze, their eyes reflecting shock and outrage.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus, please. You can't be seriou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, please. You can't be serious about this."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A republic? You mean to dismantle..."
entries.dialogueText: "A republic? You mean to dismantle the monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""A republic? You mean to abolish th..."
entries.dialogueText: "A republic? You mean to abolish the monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""A republic? You intend to dismantl..."
entries.dialogueText: "A republic? You intend to dismantle the monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""If you're committed to this course..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you're committed to this course, where does that leave the nobility?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That’s why I've brought you here -..."
entries.dialogueText: "That’s why I've brought you here -- to ensure we embrace this change together on the best possible terms."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""The same holds true for House Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same holds true for House Sazon. I did not tolerate this talk coming from Lucas, and I won't hear it coming from you."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""The same holds true for House Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same holds true for House Sazon. We will not stand for such treachery."

entries.speaker: Leona Sazon
entries.title: Leona Sazon: ""If you intend to follow through wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you intend to follow through with this, where does that leave the nobility?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You’re declaring open war on us --..."
entries.dialogueText: "You’re declaring open war on us -- a war which you cannot win!"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As head of House Toras -- your own..."
entries.dialogueText: "As head of House Toras -- your own family -- understand this..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You may have the crown, but you do..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may have the crown, but you do not have us."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Resistance to what, exactly?""
entries.dialogueText: "Resistance to what, exactly?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a tense silence followed..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a tense silence followed by uneasy glances.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The nobles exchange confused looks."
entries.dialogueText: The nobles exchange confused looks.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Come to what, exactly?""
entries.dialogueText: "Come to what, exactly?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What is this about, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is this about, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You people have taken Rizia for gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "You people have taken Rizia for granted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia is burdened by the weight of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is burdened by the weight of its history. She deserves a future unshackled from the past."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While the Crown has shouldered the..."
entries.dialogueText: "While the Crown has shouldered the cost of your greed and apathy, you grew fat on the very people you were meant to serve."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But you have failed to protect wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you have failed to protect what was entrusted to you, and now the kingdom teeters on the edge of destruction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see no heirs to this legacy, onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see no heirs to this legacy, only scavengers circling a dying institution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For it is you who are the engineer..."
entries.dialogueText: "For it is you who are the engineers of Rizia's demise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The world has outgrown kings, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The world has outgrown kings, and I refuse to be a relic hopelessly tied to a fading throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It’s time for the Crown to fall, s..."
entries.dialogueText: "It’s time for the Crown to fall, so Rizia may rise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know, I'm going to remember th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know, I'm going to remember this moment... the moment when the winds of democracy swept through the land and Rizia's nobles became footnotes in history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, who am I kidding. Speeches are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, who am I kidding. Speeches are useless. You'll never support Rizia's transformation into a republic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It leaves you free of your obligat..."
entries.dialogueText: "It leaves you free of your obligations to the Crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Exactly where you deserve to be --..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly where you deserve to be --without the power you never earned."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have failed to protect what wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have failed to protect what was entrusted, and now the kingdom teeters on the edge of destruction."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Crown may have guided us throu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Crown may have guided us through war and famine, but those victories now rest on forgotten laurels."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I see no heirs to this legacy,..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I see no heirs to this legacy, only scavengers circling a dying institution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The throne has become a symbol of..."
entries.dialogueText: "The throne has become a symbol of frailty, not strength."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You mean to dismantle the monarchy?""
entries.dialogueText: "You mean to dismantle the monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You mean to abolish the monarchy?""
entries.dialogueText: "You mean to abolish the monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""You intend to dismantle the monarc..."
entries.dialogueText: "You intend to dismantle the monarchy?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For once, you'll have to survive o..."
entries.dialogueText: "For once, you'll have to survive on merit rather than privilege."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And now, the throne has become a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now, the throne has become a symbol of frailty, not strength."
